sections.title: Enjoy, feel yourself, experience moments of happiness.
paragraphs: Treat yourself to a getaway, time just for yourself. This year I take you to a special house for my yoga retreat: we are in the Rottal at the Neue Welt Haus entirely by ourselves, with a maximum of 10 participants. Here you recharge over the weekend and connect with like-minded people who want to give themselves a weekend just for themselves.

Start your day with a morning routine of meditation, yoga and breathing. You enjoy varied yoga sessions and experiences for all the senses, combining yoga with mindfulness and the feel-good atmosphere of the house. Besides the yoga sessions and exchange, Rainer and Adrian will spoil us with their special cuisine. We have time to explore the surroundings and time for ourselves, things that often fall short in everyday life.

sections.title: I look forward to meeting you!
sections.lead: My love of yoga has accompanied me for many years. I love discovering its endless variety. Everyone lives yoga in their own way, and yet it always stands for a connection to yourself and your own heart.
bullets: A holistic approach: a class should touch body, mind and soul equally.
Yoga playfully combined with modern spirituality.
An interplay of dynamically flowing and mindfully calm moments.
For yoga newcomers and advanced practitioners.

sections.title: The venue: time for rest, movement and new energy
paragraphs: Nestled in the gentle hills of the Rottal, the Neue Welt Haus seminar house is a place of stillness, mindfulness and inspiration. It creates the setting for a yoga retreat that brings body, mind and soul into harmony. Surrounded by nature and far from everyday stress, the house invites you to breathe deeply and arrive fully within yourself.
Bright seminar rooms, a calm atmosphere and closeness to nature create ideal conditions for yoga, meditation and relaxation.

items.q: How many places are there, and is there a waiting list?
items.a: Because we respond individually to participants, places are limited to 10 people. If the weekend is fully booked, we will gladly put you on a waiting list. As soon as a place becomes free, we will get in touch.

items.q: What is included in the price, and what do I pay on site?
items.a: The course fee is €295 per person. Food, drinks and tourist tax are paid directly on site. Travel and hotel costs are not included in the price.
Travel is individual. By car from Munich to the Rottal it is about 160 km.

Yoga mat, blanket, strap, tennis ball, writing materials, scissors and weatherproof clothing, plus everything you need for your well-being and personal needs. You receive the final agenda with your registration.

Registration is binding. Because the number of participants is limited, your place is only secured once payment has been received. Course fees already paid cannot be refunded if you do not show up.

A cancellation must be made in writing before departure by 30 September 2026, in which case the course fee is refunded minus a processing fee of 10%. A replacement participant can be named. For later cancellations, the full participation fee plus accommodation must be paid. No course fees are refunded in case of illness or early departure either.
